llm.summary: The skill mostly fits code-quality review, but it includes an under-disclosed module that can publish repository findings to GitHub Discussions.

dimensions.detail: The core code-refinement workflow is coherent, but modules/insight-generation.md adds external publication of medium/high findings to GitHub Discussions, which is not disclosed in the main purpose of improving local code quality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Several triggers are appropriate, but broad triggers like "craft" plus execution modes for applying all findings create wider activation and mutation scope than a review-only skill; the publishing module also lacks an explicit user-confirmation gate.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is markdown-only with no bundled executable scripts and VirusTotal telemetry is clean; it references optional plugin/config dependencies and an external claude-night-market source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Repository-wide find/grep scanning is proportionate for code analysis, but posting findings through a hardcoded local path and external Python script is not proportionate or portable for the stated refinement purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No daemon or background persistence is present, but the workflow can create commits/docs during execution and the insight module can create persistent public GitHub Discussion posts containing code locations and evidence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use it only in repositories where repo-wide code analysis and possible refactoring are acceptable, and do not enable or invoke the insight-generation module unless you explicitly want findings published to GitHub Discussions after checking the content for sensitive paths, snippets, or internal issues.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed in artifact: the insight module instructs posting refinement findings to GitHub Discussions after analysis. This is adjacent to tracking, but not disclosed in the main code-refinement workflow and can expose repository details.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed in artifact: the module includes a Python snippet importing post_findings from an external local plugin path. It is not bundled and may fail, but the outbound posting behavior lacks clear consent, destination scoping, or redaction safeguards.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Partly confirmed: refactoring, algorithms, and duplication are good triggers, while vague activation terms such as "craft" broaden when this skill may run.
